newsitem.title: UK: UK announces 5-yr oil exploration plan, 18th round.
newsitem.headline: UK announces 5-yr oil exploration plan, 18th round.

text.p: Britain on Wednesday announced a five-year oil and gas exploration plan and said an 18th offshore licensing round would open this year.
The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) said the 18th round would cover mature areas in the north, central and southern North Sea and the Morecambe and Liverpool Bay areas of the Irish Sea.
A formal announcement will be made in the autumn giving 90 days notice for applications. Awards are scheduled for Easter 1998.
Each subsequent year licensing rounds would offer "a mixture of mature and semi-mature provinces," the DTI said.
A new frontier round, probably a 21st round, would be scheduled for the autumn of 2000, the department said.
